title: August-origin physical injury-report risk and combined draft score

forecast_origin.rule: A feature must be available by the target season's August origin or come from a completed earlier season.

outcome.name: physical_injury_reported
outcome.positive_rule: At least one report or practice injury field contains a physical designation during the regular season.
outcome.interpretation: The label is an observed official-report event, not proof of tissue damage, games missed, or a latent medical condition. A candidate with no matched physical report is labeled 0.

population.candidate_rule: Use the locked Phase 2 August cohort: prior-season roster members plus target-year draft or combine entrants, with the current August roster used only for 2026 inference.
population.known_limitation: Historical candidate membership does not reconstruct an exact August roster. Players who leave the league can remain observed negatives.

injury_history: physical injury reported at target season minus 2 through minus 5
physical injury report weeks at target season minus 2 through minus 5
physical injury designation count at target season minus 2 through minus 5
features.selection_rule: Rank inputs inside each base-training fold by absolute distance of univariate ROC AUC from 0.5. Selection cannot see calibration or validation labels.

development.fold_rule: For validation season y, fit feature selection and the base classifier through y-2, calibrate probabilities on y-1, and score y.
development.calibration: Sigmoid calibration fitted only on y-1. Logistic candidates are also recalibrated so every candidate follows the same probability contract.
development.selection: Find the best mean development ROC AUC. Among candidates within 0.005, select the lowest mean log loss; then fewer features; then lexical candidate identifier.
development.negative_control: Repeat the selected pipeline for 11 target permutations within season and position. The mean pooled ROC AUC must lie from 0.45 through 0.55.

audit.success_rule: The clustered-bootstrap lower 95% bound for pooled ROC AUC must exceed 0.5 and mean ROC AUC must exceed the age-position baseline by at least 0.02.

production.fit_rule: Fit the locked base procedure through 2023, calibrate on 2024, and infer 2026. No 2025 injury label is imputed.
production.combined_score: 100 * (0.80 * within-position percentile of raw Phase 2 predicted points + 0.20 * calibrated probability of no physical injury report)
production.interpretation: The combined score is a draft preference index, not expected fantasy points. The 80/20 weight is a declared user-facing preference and is not tuned on audit outcomes.
